findings.summary: Core requirements R1 (directory recursion) and R3 (CommonMark parsing) are scheduled for implementation in Milestone M3, missing the sample check target of Milestones M1 or M2.

evidence.note: Plan schedules full R1 implementation (Ingestion Plugin) in Milestone M3.
evidence.quote: Ingestion Plugin (C11) implementing directory input, recursive discovery, default .md inclusion... (R1)

evidence.note: Plan schedules full R3 implementation (Markdown Render Plugin) in Milestone M3.
evidence.quote: Markdown Render Plugin (C14) implementing CommonMark-compliant parsing... (R3)

findings.summary: Deterministic sample check for R1 maps milestones to M1/M2, but the plan’s actual implementation + validation for recursive .md discovery and related acceptance testing is scheduled in M3 (Ingestion + Markdown render plugins).

evidence.note: Sample check claims R1 is covered by milestones M1 and M2 only.
M3 explicitly delivers the ingestion behavior required by R1 (recursive discovery, default .md inclusion).
evidence.quote: Ingestion Plugin (C11) implementing directory input, recursive discovery, default .md inclusion

evidence.note: M3 exit criteria includes passing AT1 (the acceptance test mapped to R1).
evidence.quote: AT1, AT3, AT4, AT5, and AT6 pass for the ingestion/render path

findings.routing_target: Orchestrator: trace_graph_mapper (correct requirement-to-milestone coverage for R1 to include M3)
